Case Keenum turned a surprise start into a statement win.

With Caleb Williams sidelined, the 38-year-old made his first NFL start since 2023 and led Chicago to a 27–7 win over previously unbeaten Philadelphia. Keenum completed 24 of 34 passes for 247 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions.

The Bears improved to 2–1, while the Eagles’ offense managed just seven points. That sideline shot of DeVonta Smith and Jalen Hurts sums up Philadelphia’s night.

Jaxson Dart is an NFL quarterback who played college football at USC before transferring to Ole Miss, where he developed into one of the SEC’s top quarterbacks. Known for his strong arm, mobility, toughness, and ability to extend plays, Dart led one of the nation’s most productive offenses during his time with the Rebels. Following a successful college career, he entered the NFL as a highly regarded quarterback prospect. He is recognized for his competitive mentality, athleticism, and playmaking ability both inside and outside the pocket.

Tom Brady was a magician in the pocket 😮‍💨🐐

Brady’s pocket awareness was probably the best the NFL has ever seen. He wasn’t mobile, but he had an elite feel for pressure and rarely wasted movement.

He spent 20 seasons with the New England Patriots (2000–2019). In the regular season, he completed 6,377 of 9,988 passes (63.8%) for 74,571 yards, 541 touchdowns and 179 interceptions, posting a 97.0 passer rating and a 219–64 starting record. 

With New England, Brady also won three NFL MVP awards and helped lead the Patriots to nine Super Bowl appearances. His 2007 season was one of his best: 4,806 yards, 50 TDs, 8 INTs and a 117.2 passer rating.

Gronk never let Brady down. 🐐🏈

When the pressure was at its highest and the game was hanging in the balance, Tom Brady always had one terrifying option waiting downfield — Rob Gronkowski. 🔥

The Brady-to-Gronk connection became one of the most iconic quarterback-tight end duos in NFL history, built on trust, timing, physicality, football IQ, and an almost unfair ability to make huge plays when they mattered most.

Whether it was a red-zone touchdown, contested catch, deep seam route, third-down conversion, or a clutch play in the biggest moments, Gronk had a way of turning Brady’s passes into unforgettable highlights. 💪

Brady delivered the ball.
Gronk delivered the moment.
And defenses had to deal with both. 😮‍💨

From regular-season dominance to Super Bowl greatness, their chemistry became a defining part of the Patriots dynasty and one of the most recognizable connections the NFL has ever seen.

Two legends.
One connection.
Countless unforgettable plays. 🐐🐐

Brady to Gronk will always hit different. 🤯🔥
